88960.meaning1: is spoken of; is referred to; is expressed (with)
88960.commentary: (DNt) avayavesu siddho viseso samudāyassa visesako hotī'ti ekam'pi raṭṭhaṃ bahuvacanena vohariyati.

examples.text: erāvaṇo mahānāgo'ti erāvaṇo ca devaputto, jātiyā nāgo na hoti. nāgavohārena pan'esa vohariyati.
uttarakuruto āgatamanussehi āvasitapadeso kururaṭṭhan'ti nāmaṃ labhi, bahuke pana gāmanigam'ādayo upādāya bahuvacanena vohariyati. tena vuttaṃ, kurūsu viharatī'ti.

anuviloketvā parisan'ti bhagavato sakasamaye pañhapucchanena udake miyamāno ukkhipitvā thale ṭhapito viya samapassaddhakāyacitto hutvā parisaṃ saṅgaṇhan'atthaṃ diṭṭhisañjānen'eva upadhārentu me bhonto vacanan'ti vadanto viya anuviloketvā parisaṃ bhagavantaṃ etadavoca.

anuviloketvā parisan'ti bhagavato sakasamaye pañhapucchanena udake miyamāno ukkhipitvā thale ṭhapito viya samapassaddhakāyacitto hutvā parisaṃ saṅgaṇhan'atthaṃ diṭṭhisañjānen'eva upadhārentu me bhonto vacanan'ti vadanto viya anuviloketvā parisaṃ bhagavantaṃ etadavoca.

88963.commentary: (DNt) samay'antaran'ti diṭṭhivisesā, nānāvihitā diṭṭhiyo'ti attho, aññasamayaṃ vā.

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? vinayapaññattiṃ, bhūmantaraṃ, paccay'ākāraṃ, samay'antaran'ti.

88964.commentary: (PYt) sakasamayo ca samay'antaro ca sakasamaya-samay'antarā, te'y'eva pana gahanasadisattā gahanan'ti sakasamaya-samay'antaragahanaṃ, tassa ajjhogāhaṇaṃ sakasamaya-samay'antaragahan'ajjhogāhaṇaṃ, tasmiṃ samattho sakasamaya-samay'antara-gahan'ajjhogāhaṇa-samattho.

examples.text: tassa idha nikkhepappayojanaṃ vatvā tato paraṃ suparisuddhena titthena naditaḷāk'ādīsu salil'ajjhogāhaṇam'iva suparisuddhena nidānena imassa suttassa atth'ajjhogāhaṇaṃ dassetuṃ…

88965.commentary: (ADHa) diṭṭhiṃ ujuṃ karontassa diṭṭhi'jukammaṃ puññakiriyavatthu' nāma. dīghabhāṇakā pan'āhu, diṭṭhi'jukammaṃ sabbesaṃ niyamalakkhaṇaṃ, yaṃkiñci puññaṃ karontassa hi diṭṭhiyā ujukabhāveneva mahapphalaṃ hotī'ti.

examples.text: taṃ atthato buddh'ādīsu vatthūsu saddhāpaṭilābho saddhāmūlikā ca sammādiṭṭhi dasasu puññakiriyavatthūsu diṭṭhi-ujukamman'ti vuccati.

88966.commentary: (ADHa) diṭṭhiṃ ujuṃ karontassa diṭṭhi'jukammaṃ puññakiriyavatthu' nāma. dīghabhāṇakā pan'āhu, diṭṭhi'jukammaṃ sabbesaṃ niyamalakkhaṇaṃ, yaṃkiñci puññaṃ karontassa hi diṭṭhiyā ujukabhāveneva mahapphalaṃ hotī'ti.

examples.text: taṃ atthato buddh'ādīsu vatthūsu saddhāpaṭilābho saddhāmūlikā ca sammādiṭṭhi dasasu puññakiriyavatthūsu diṭṭhi'jukamman'ti vuccati.

88967.meaning1: single heap of meat; single pile of flesh

examples.text: ekamaṃsakhalan'ti ekamaṃsarāsiṃ. puñjan'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ.

88968.meaning1: heap of meat; pile of flesh
88968.commentary: (MNt) khaliyati samādiyatī'ti khalaṃ, rāsī'ti āha, ekaṃ maṃsakhalan'ti ekaṃ maṃsarāsin'ti.

examples.text: ekaṃ maṃsakhalan'ti ekaṃ maṃsarāsiṃ. puñjan'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ.
katamo nu kho, bhante, māradhammo'ti? rūpaṃ kho, rādha, māradhammo, vedanā māradhammo, saññā māradhammo, saṅkhārā māradhammo, viññāṇaṃ māradhammo.

88970.commentary: (UDa) ghaṭiyā'ti bhattaghaṭito. ghaṭi-odanan'ti'pi pāṭho, tassa ghaṭi-odanaṃ nāma devānaṃ koci āhāraviseso'ti atthaṃ vadanti.

examples.text: disvāna gharā nikkhamitvā paccugantvā hatthato pattaṃ gahetvā gharaṃ pavisitvā ghaṭiyā odanaṃ uddharitvā pattaṃ pūretvā āyasmato mahākassapassa adāsi.

88971.meaning1: wretched woman; miserable woman; pitiful woman

examples.text: aho dānaṃ varākiyā, kassape suppatiṭṭhitaṃ, parābhatena dānena, ijjhittha vata dakkhiṇā.

88972.meaning1: name of a woman in a Vimānavatthu story

examples.text: tassa anukampāya khīṇ'āsavā dūrato'pi āgantvā dānaṃ sampaṭicchanti. revatī pana tasmiṃ gate katipāhameva dānaṃ pavattetvā anāthānaṃ bhattaṃ upacchindi, bhikkhūnam'pi bhattaṃ kaṇājakaṃ bilaṅgadutiyaṃ adāsi.
ālambo gaggaro bhīmo, sādhuvādī ca saṃsayo, pokkharo ca suphasso ca, viṇāmokkhā ca nāriyo.

88974.meaning1: wake up; awakening; wake up call

examples.text: āmantanikā rañño'mhi, sakkassa vasavattino, saṭṭhi turiya sahassāni, paṭibodhaṃ karonti me.
magadhesu aṅgesu ca satthavāhā, āropayitvā paṇiyaṃ puthuttaṃ, te yāmase sindhusovīrabhūmiṃ, dhan'atthikā uddayaṃ patthayānā.
magadhesu aṅgesu ca satthavāhā, āropayitvā paṇiyaṃ puthuttaṃ, te yāmase sindhusovīrabhūmiṃ, dhan'atthikā uddayaṃ patthayānā.
magadhesu aṅgesu ca satthavāhā, āropayitvā paṇiyaṃ puthuttaṃ, te yāmase sindhusovīrabhūmiṃ, dhan'atthikā uddayaṃ patthayānā.

88978.meaning1: fourteenth day of the lunar fortnight

examples.text: catuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ, yā ca pakkhassa aṭṭhamī, pāṭihāriyapakkhañ'ca, aṭṭh'aṅgasusamāgataṃ.

88979.meaning1: name of a female lay disciple

examples.text: mama ca, bhante, vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandeyyāsi, lakhumā nāma, bhante, upāsikā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī'ti.

88980.meaningLit: who causes to actively wake up

examples.text: eṇīphassā suphassā ca, subhaddā muduvādinī, etā c'aññā ca seyyāse, accharānaṃ pabodhikā.
manussabhūtā daharā apāpikā, pasannacittā patimābhirādhayiṃ, divā ca ratto ca manāpacārinī, ahaṃ pure sīlavatī ahosiṃ.
aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ aparimitaṃ sukh'āvahaṃ, uposathaṃ satatam'upāvasiṃ ahaṃ, kat'āvāsā katakusalā tato cutā, sayaṃ pabhā anuvicarāmi nandanan'ti.

88983.synonym: apanudi, apānudi, ahāsi, panudi, byapānudi, vinodesi

examples.text: samaṇo ca kho āsi kumārakassapo, bahussuto cittakathī uḷāro, so me tadā dhammakathaṃ abhāsi [akāsi], diṭṭhivisūkāni vinodayī me.

88984.meaning1: worthy of an invitation (of); able to discuss (with)
88984.commentary: (VVa) āmantanikā rañño'mhi, sakkassa vasavattino'ti… tassa vasavattino sakkassa devarañño āmantanikā ālāpasallāpayoggā, kīḷanakāle vā tena āmantetabbā amhi, nikkamassa vīriyassa phalaṃ passā'ti yojanā.

examples.text: āmantanikā rañño'mhi, sakkassa vasavattino, saṭṭhi turiya sahassāni, paṭibodhaṃ karonti me.

88985.meaning1: wearing a head wreath; with a floral crown

examples.text: pucchāmi taṃ uppalamāladhārinī, āveḷinī kañcanasannibhattace, alaṅ'kate uttamavatthadhārinī, kā tvaṃ subhe devate vandase mamaṃ.
serīsako nāma aham'hi yakkho, kantāriyo vaṇṇ'upathamhi gutto, imaṃ padesaṃ abhipālayāmi, vacanakaro vessavaṇassa rañño'ti.

88987.commentary: (VVa) nānāratanakappano'ti nānāvidhāni ratanāni etesan'ti nānāratanā, kumbh'ālaṅ'kār'ādi-hatth'ālaṅkārā. tehi vihito kappanno sannāho yassa so nānāratanakappano.

examples.text: kuñjaro te var'āroho, nānāratanakappano, ruciro thāmavā javasampanno, ākāsamhi samīhati.
icc'eva vatvāna yamassa dūtā, te dve yakkhā lohit'akkhā brahantā, paccekabāhāsu gahetvā revataṃ, pakkāmayuṃ devagaṇassa santike.

88989.synonym: ussajjati, osajjati, ossajjati, pamuñcati, pamocayati, mocayati, moceti, vimoceti

examples.text: santike maraṇaṃ tuyhaṃ, oraṃ māsehi pañcahi, rājaputta vijānāhi, attānaṃ parimocayā'ti.

88990.meaning1: having declared; having reported; having made known

examples.text: te tattha sabb'eva ahaṃ pure'ti, upāsakattaṃ paṭivedayitvā, pakkāmi sattho anumodamāno, yakkh'iddhiyā anumato punappunaṃ.

88991.meaning1: to ask; to take permission (from someone to do something)

examples.text: iti'ssā sassu paribhāsi, avinītā'si tvaṃ vadhu, na maṃ sampucchituṃ icchi, samaṇassa dadām'ahaṃ.

88992.commentary: (VINa) paribhāsī'ti tā bhikkhuniyo mā puna evaṃ karitthā'ti santajjesi.

examples.text: ahaṃ pure maccharinī ahosiṃ, paribhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ, vitathena ca sāmikaṃ vañcayitvā, paccām'ahaṃ niraye ghorarūpe'ti.

88994.meaning1: with round digits; with rounded fingers and toes

examples.text: tā kambukeyūradharā suvāsasā, sumajjhimā ūruthan'ūpapannā, vaṭṭ'aṅguliyo sumukhā sudassanā, rathe ṭhitā pañjalikā upaṭṭhitā.
tā kambukāyūradharā suvatthā, vaṭṭ'aṅgulī tambatal'ūpapannā, paggayha pāyenti anomavaṇṇā, n'etādisaṃ atthi manussaloke, kiṃ patthayaṃ nāga tapo karosi.

88995.construction: abhi > abhy > abbh + ud + dhunā + nta
88995.commentary: (VVa) abbhuddhunantā'ti kammasippinā sukate suṭṭhu nimmite khuddakaghaṇṭ'ādi-ass'ālaṅkāre abhiuddhunantā adhikaṃ uddhunantā.

examples.text: dhunanti vagganti patanti c'ambare, abbhuddhunantā sukate piḷandhane, tesaṃ saro suyyati vaggurūpo, pañc'aṅgikaṃ turiyam'ivappavāditaṃ.
na'y'īdam'appassa katassa kammuno, pubbe suciṇṇassa uposathassa vā, iddh'ānubhāvo vipulo ayaṃ tava, yaṃ devasaṅghaṃ abhirocase bhusaṃ.
manussabhūtā daharā apāpikā, pasannacittā patim'ābhirādhayiṃ, sadevaraṃ sassasuraṃ sadāsakaṃ, abhirādhayiṃ tamhi kato yaso mama.

88998.commentary: (VVa) kusaka-suphullita-lat'āvalambinīhī'ti kusakehi tāla-nāḷiker'ādīhi tiṇajātīhi olambamānāhi santānakavalli-ādīhi suṭṭhu kusumitalatāhi ca saṃyuttāti yojanā.

examples.text: saḷalalabujabhujaka saṃyuttā, kusaka-suphullita-lat'āvalambinīhi, maṇijālasadisā yasassinī, rammā pokkharaṇī upaṭṭhitā te.

88999.commentary: (VVa) kusaka-suphullita-lat'āvalambinīhī'ti kusakehi tāla-nāḷiker'ādīhi tiṇajātīhi olambamānāhi santānakavalli-ādīhi suṭṭhu kusumitalatāhi ca saṃyuttāti yojanā.

examples.text: saḷalalabujabhujaka saṃyuttā, kusaka-suphullita-latā-avalambinīhi, maṇijālasadisā yasassinī, rammā pokkharaṇī upaṭṭhitā te.
